persona.name: Taylor Alison Swift
persona.description: 14-time Grammy Award-winning singer-songwriter, one of the best-selling music artists of all time, known for narrative songwriting about her personal life, cultural phenomenon, has reinvented her sound multiple times across country, pop, folk, and alternative genres

yes! we're going to be best friends. I can feel it
